title: forge vuln list document (forge.dev/vuln-list/v1)
description: What a release's artifacts are known to be vulnerable to, and what the env's vuln_gate makes of it: the output of `forge vuln list|show|scan --json`. Generated from the Go type forge encodes it with.

env.description: Env is the env whose policy judged the findings; "" for a scan that named no env (it is judged by the default policy).

release.description: Release is the release scanned; "" for a directory or image scan.

coverage.description: Coverage says how much of the release was scanned.

db.description: DB says which scanner and database build the findings came from.

gate.description: Gate is the env's vuln_gate verdict over every finding, whatever the filters: a filter narrows what is listed, never what is judged.

counts.description: Counts are the listed findings by severity (negligible counts as low).

findings.description: Findings are the listed findings, strongest first.

notes.description: Notes say what the reader should know about the data: why nothing could be rescanned (no scanner, no database, a stale database), and why the verdict is undetermined.

Coverage.description: Coverage is how much of a release was scanned.

artifacts.description: Artifacts is how many artifacts the release has.

with_sbom.description: WithSBOM is how many of them have a stored SBOM.

scanned.description: Scanned is how many of those have a scan.

unscanned.description: Unscanned names each artifact with no SBOM or no scan, with why.

DocumentDB.description: DocumentDB is the freshness of a document's findings.

scanner.description: Scanner and Version name the tool ("grype", "v0.122.1").

built_at.description: BuiltAt is the build of the OLDEST database any listed artifact was scanned with: the document is only as fresh as that.

stale.description: Stale reports that BuiltAt is older than five days (StaleAfter): the verdict is then "stale", exit 2, whatever the findings say.

DocumentFinding.description: DocumentFinding is one advisory on one package, across the release's artifacts.

id.description: ID is the advisory the scanner matched (CVE-…, GHSA-…, GO-…).

aliases.description: Aliases are the other identifiers of the same advisory (the CVE of a GHSA). An exemption of any of them covers the finding.

severity.description: Severity is the scanner's label, normalized.

cvss.description: CVSS is the highest CVSS base score the database records for the advisory, absent when it records none.

kev.description: KEV reports that the advisory is on CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list.

epss.description: EPSS is the probability of exploitation in the next 30 days (0..1), and EPSSPercentile its percentile, when the database has a score.

package.description: Package is the component the advisory matched.

fixed_in.description: FixedIn are the versions that fix it, when a fix exists.

fix_state.description: FixState is fixed, not-fixed, wont-fix, or "" when unknown.

match_type.description: MatchType is the strongest way the scanner matched it: exact-direct-match, exact-indirect-match or cpe-match.

confidence.description: Confidence is high for an exact match and low for a CPE-only one.

locations.description: Locations are where in the scanned artifact the package was found.

url.description: URL is the advisory's page in the source the match came from.

artifacts.description: Artifacts are the release artifacts the package is in. Empty (never absent) for a finding its source attributes to the release as a whole and to no artifact; text output says "release" for it. Such a finding is judged, counted and listed like any other.

first_seen.description: FirstSeen is the first stored scan that reported it.

exemption.description: Exemption is the env's exemption that covers it, when one does.

action.description: Action is what the vuln_gate rule makes of it: block, warn or none.

Exemption.description: Exemption is an accepted advisory, as the env declares it (forge.VulnExemption): time-boxed, with its reason.

GateResult.description: GateResult is the gate block of the vuln-list document.

mode.description: Mode is the env's vuln_gate mode: off, audit or enforce.

graded_as.description: GradedAs is the mode the gate is judged at: the declared mode, except that the warn-first rollout grades an enforce as audit until the project's forge pin reaches the vuln-gate rule's GatesFrom release (internal/cli/lint/rollout_grade.go). The caller grades; Evaluate records what it was told (EvaluateInput.GradedAs).

blocking.description: Blocking are the ids of the advisories that block, sorted, each once.

determined.description: Determined is false when the verdict is "could not determine" (stale, unscanned): the exit code is 2, and the document's notes say why.

judged_by.description: JudgedBy says whose judgement of each finding the verdict is: "control-plane" when the env's control plane judged them (it is authoritative for an env whose ledger it keeps). Absent for an env whose ledger is this machine's, which forge judges by definition. "local" is reserved for a verdict forge gave in a control plane's stead; this forge never gives one (a control plane that cannot judge the env is "could not determine").

Package.description: Package is the component a finding is in.

name.description: Name and Version as the SBOM names them.

purl.description: PURL is the package URL, when the SBOM gives one.

type.description: Type is the ecosystem: go-module, npm, apk, deb, python, binary, ...

UnscannedArtifact.description: UnscannedArtifact is an artifact the verdict could not cover.
